name: Audio Innovations & TJ's Electric
old_description: AN INNOVATIVE, AUDIO VISUAL COMPANY THAT DESIGNS, INTEGRATES AND SIMPLIFIES
about:
Audio Innovations & TJ's Electric operates from Hailey, Idaho, in the Wood River Valley. Founded in 1992 by Jess Goitiandia, the company began as a provider of audio-visual solutions tailored to the local community.

The firm designs, integrates, and installs audio and video systems, lighting controls, automation platforms, and acoustic treatments for residential and commercial projects. Services span home theaters, conference rooms, whole-home automation, smart lighting, and studio-grade acoustic conditioning. No facility size or headcount figures are disclosed.

Clients include homeowners, commercial developers, and operators of recording studios, offices, theaters, and conference facilities across the Wood River Valley region. The company works with both new construction and retrofit projects.

Goitiandia emphasizes a commitment to innovation and adaptability, citing deep community knowledge and a focus on seamless, high-quality experiences as the foundation of the business.
